fullDescription: A high-end, dark-themed SaaS landing page style guide characterized by an 80px geometric perspective grid, tech-inspired data visualizations, and ultra-modern typography. Dominant charcoal-black (#090909) aesthetics with vibrant coral-orange (#ff5c35) accents. Ideal for fintech, AI analytics platforms, and enterprise software looking for a sophisticated, technical, and high-performance brand identity. Features glassmorphism navigation and interactive, mouse-tracking background masks.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated dark-mode tech aesthetic featuring deep charcoal backgrounds, subtle grid systems, and data-visualization-inspired SVG elements. It prioritizes clean whitespace, bold sans-serif typography, and high-contrast call-to-action elements.

## Estilo Visual
Create a UI with a #090909 background. Implement a background grid using 1px lines of rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) spaced at 80px intervals. Use a radial mask (black to transparent 90%) to reveal the grid selectively. Typography: Headers in 'Satoshi' or 'Inter', weight 700, tracking -0.05em, leading 1.05. Body text in weight 300/400, size 18px-20px, color #9ca3af. Accents: Use #ff5c35 for interactive node lines with a 4px glow (drop-shadow). Buttons: Primary is solid white with black text; Secondary is rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) with a 1px border. Navigation: Glassmorphism with 10px backdrop-blur and 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) border.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Height 80px, max-width 1280px. Left side: 32px white square logo with black SVG icon, followed by horizontal nav links (Product, Resources, Pricing) in text-gray-300, 14px size. Right side: 'Log in' link and a compact 'Try free' white button. Use glassmorphism background (blur 10px).

### Hero Section
Centered text container (max-width 1024px). Top: Announcement badge with a blue 10px square icon and 11px uppercase bold tracking 0.2em text. Title: H1 font-size 88px, bold, white, 'Real-time customer intelligence'. Subtitle: max-width 640px, font-size 20px, color gray-400, font-light. CTA group: two 56px height buttons with rounded-xl corners (12px), 32px horizontal padding.

### Visual Elements
On the right side of hero: SVG tech-map with lines (rgba 255,255,255,0.15) and nodes (10px squares). Include accent paths in #ff5c35. Add a 'floating' animation (6s ease-in-out) to crosshair elements. Left side: Floating 'plus' icons and small 8px gray-600 squares at 30% opacity.

### Logo Section
Horizontal strip below hero. 1px top border (rgba 255,255,255,0.05). Logos displayed in a flex row with 48px gap, grayscale, 40% opacity. Upon hover, transition to 100% opacity over 700ms.

### Footer
Background #111111, border-top 1px white/5. Left: Brand logo and name. Right: 'curated by' text in light-weight gray, followed by collaborator logo in white. Padding 16px 32px.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Perspective Grid — A background system that reacts to mouse movement.
CSS Background: linear-gradients create an 80px grid. JS: Mousemove listener updates a CSS variable for mask-position. Mask: radial-gradient(circle at var(--mouse-x) var(--mouse-y), black, transparent 90%). Effect: The grid only appears near the user's cursor.

### Tech Node SVG — Abstract data-flow visualization.
SVG container with 'preserveAspectRatio'. Paths use stroke-width 1 with rgba(255,255,255,0.15). Accent paths use #ff5c35 and filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px #ff5c35). Nodes are 10x10px squares with transparent fills and 1px white strokes.

## Notas Especiais
Must maintain a strict dark theme; never use pure black #000, use #090909 instead. Ensure all interactive elements have a transition of at least 200ms ease. The grid must be interactive, following the mouse cursor via a CSS mask-image radial gradient. Headings must have tight letter-spacing (-0.05em) to achieve the 'editorial tech' look.

style.description: The design uses a core palette of deep blacks (#090909) and crisp white text, with secondary accents of electric coral (#ff5c35) and deep blue. Typography is led by 'Satoshi' for a modern, geometric feel, supported by 'Inter' for readability. Key visual motifs include 80px square grids, radial gradients that mask background patterns, and thin-line SVG 'node' maps that signify connectivity and intelligence.
